body:
Source observation: cps/cwa_functions.py refresh_library invokes ingest_processor.py and maps every return2 to the translated message that the book ingest service is already running. Exit2 is also used for runtime initialization failures; proposed1158 additionally uses it for an existing source still held by a writer, preserving the retry queue after a reopened-writer check. That source-deferred result would therefore produce the running-service message even when the blocker is the writer. The complete browser/HTTP trigger has not been executed in this audit, and the1158 busy-source branch is proposed rather than merged at capture.

Keep queue/defer signaling for source preservation. Distinguish lock contention, initialization failure and busy-source deferral in the refresh result, or use an accurate shared message. Verify the actual refresh completion message and subsequent retry for both lock-held and source-held cases. This is a separate translated usability change, not part of page-based conversion budgets. No new user issue or public promise is created.
title: Manual library refresh interprets every ingest exit2 as an already-running service
